title: Help for character creation
author: Gazowa
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I’ve been developing a game for several months with the help of Claude, various software tools, and a bit of coding. I’m currently working with Unity 6.

I’d like to add a character creation system at the beginning of the game, allowing players to customize their face, body shape, hairstyle, clothes, etc.

I’ve managed to integrate Unity’s character creation system, but I find it quite limited and I’m struggling to   
achieve a really good-looking result.

I’ve seen what MetaHuman offers in Unreal Engine, and I really like the quality, but I haven’t been able to find anything quite as good for Unity.

Do you have any software or solutions you would recommend for creating a high-quality character customization system in Unity 6?  
Thanks for your help!
